title: ICON 1.5 — The Character Sheet
description: A walk through the player character sheet, tab by tab. Needs a player character you own.

steps.title: Your character sheet
steps.content:
This tour opens your character sheet and walks through it tab by tab.
Nothing is changed on your character: the tour only shows where things are.

steps.title: Header
steps.content: Name, portrait, jobs (the ★ primary job sets your class, base stats, traits and Limit Break), level and chapter. A brand-new character shows a Character Setup Wizard button here until it has a job.

steps.title: Quick Guide
steps.content: Opens the ICON Quick Guide: how a turn works, animated pictures of every area (blasts, bursts, lines, arcs, auras), the searchable glossary and an FAQ of edge cases.

steps.title: Tabs
steps.content: Narrative for life outside the fight, Combat for the tactical game, Conditions for statuses and saves, Relics, and Notes with the character management tools.

steps.title: XP and Level Up
steps.content: Click the pips or use − / + to track XP. At 15 XP press Level Up: the wizard offers exactly the choices your new level gives (abilities, talents, masteries, relics, bond powers). The wand reopens the creation wizard for a level 0 character.

steps.title: Bond, Burdens, Ambitions, Gear
steps.content: Your Bond and its powers, Burdens and Ambitions (click a clock segment to fill it), Gear Kit, Dust, Effort and Strain.

steps.title: Narrative Actions
steps.content: Your narrative actions and their ratings. Click an action's name to roll it: a dialog asks for difficulty and any extra dice, then the result goes to chat.

steps.title: HP, Vigor and class resources
steps.content: Hit points with wounds, Vigor (the temporary shield over HP) and the resources of your class, such as Vigilance, Blessing Tokens, Aether or power dice.

steps.title: Basic actions
steps.content: Attacks and actions every character has (p.85). rolls the attack against your targets; the range is shown as a reminder.

steps.title: Stats and saves
steps.content: Vitality, Defense, Speed, Armor, Fray and your damage die, worked out from your job and level. The save bar rolls a save (1d20, 10+).

steps.title: Equipped abilities
steps.content: Drag abilities into the slots. Click one to see its details, double-click to open it; the buttons on each slot roll the attack or the damage, or post it to chat. The lock protects talents, masteries and the remove buttons from accidental clicks during play.

steps.title: Limit Break and Resolve
steps.content: From level 2 your Limit Break lives here. Use Limit Break spends Resolve, any mix of your personal Resolve and the party pool (p.99) — the party pool is shared, so ask your team first.

steps.title: Conditions
steps.content: Click a status to apply or remove it; the ones marked auto change your rolls by themselves. Active negative statuses get a Save button here.

steps.title: Relics
steps.content: Drag relics here from the Relics compendium. Each card shows its rank and lets you upgrade it with Dust.

steps.title: Character Management
steps.content: AP, masteries and skill ranks spent against what your levels have earned, with a warning if you overspend. ↻ Refocus refunds everything so you can rebuild; ❔ Guide reopens the character building guide.
